summary: Vantage Corp (Singapore), a NYSE American-listed tanker shipbroking firm filing as a foreign private issuer on Form 6-K, announced that subsidiary Hado Pte. Ltd. commercialized its proprietary cloud platform OpsWiz and signed Felcor Petroleum Pte. Ltd. as its first external customer, initially for demurrage management with planned expansion into trade capture, automated cargo pricing and inventory integration. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, closing date or structural mechanics were disclosed. This is an ordinary product-commercialization and customer-win announcement, not a special situation; watch for disclosure of recurring subscription revenue or further customer additions.
